Health Functional FoodVitamin A 210μgVitamin B12 0.72μgVitamin B2 0.42mgVitamin C 30mgVitamin D 3μgSelenium 17μgIodine 51μgOnce a day

프리미엄멀티비타민미네랄Vitamin A · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Selenium · Iodine

Made by 에스케이내추럴팜(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 210μg of Vitamin A, 0.72μg of Vitamin B12, 0.42mg of Vitamin B2, 30mg of Vitamin C, 3μg of Vitamin D, 17μg of Selenium, 51μg of Iodine as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 210μg Vitamin A, 0.72μg Vitamin B12, 0.42mg Vitamin B2, 30mg Vitamin C, 3μg Vitamin D, 17μg Selenium, 51μg Iodine
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 에스케이내추럴팜(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
    • Needed for energy production
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Iodine
    • Needed for energy production in the body
    • Needed for the synthesis of thyroid hormones
    • Needed for energy production
    • Needed for neural development

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Vitamin A labelled (210μg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B12 labelled (0.72μg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (0.42mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (30mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (3μg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Selenium labelled (17μg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Iodine labelled (51μg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Appearance 미황색의 원형 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 습기가 적고 직사광선을 받지 않는 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin A · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Selenium · Iodine together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
